column1: # The stage checklists a package can have. key: the name in --checklists and in lists/plans.tsv. stage: the checklist's name, as in lists/checklists.tsv and its issue title. opens: when the Set up this repository step opens it (shown beside it in the form). qc has no issue of its own: its boxes are sections of Next release (release qc in lists/checklists.tsv), so choosing it needs next-release too.
# Keep the columns tab-separated, with no hash sign inside a cell (lists treat it as a comment).

column3: From the first run: your own code, the repository files, CI and the repository settings every package needs.
While the repository is private: what to do before you make it public.
Once the repository is public: the settings and extras that come with being public.
For a package going to CRAN: what to check before you submit it.
Once the package is on CRAN: what to do after it is accepted.
A fresh list for each release: from the first run for a package not for CRAN, once the package is on CRAN for one that is.
For teams with a quality process: adds the scope, tests, review and evidence sections to each Next release.
